fusions.name: Eight Holds
fusions.desc: Bites for 12 damage and makes the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Scrum
fusions.desc: Thrashes at every enemy within 3 tiles, dealing 4 damage. The damage rises 8% for each affliction on the target, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Wrestler's Hold
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 50% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it.

fusions.name: Worry the Wounded
fusions.desc: You deal 12% more damage to enemies carrying an affliction.
